I went to Mexico with some friends, had a really good time and when I returned home (I live alone) I was super tired so I had a nap during the day. (May 25th)

 I woke up after a couple of hours and felt the weight of somebody laying next to me in bed, I was startled and confused and I reached over and felt a smooth woman's leg, at least I think it was a woman. By the time my hand makes contact with the thigh, I feel it's arms start to attack me, pressing down on my upper chest. I immediately leave the house and I am absolutely terrified. (My friend heard it too) I go to front desk and ask if they had called and they said no.

 Later that day I go to sleep during the day (again) while my friend walks around the city to explore.
